text: The power gate is a step table: 35% of damage from 40% of recommended power, 15% from 20%.
Since the 2026-09-23 easing, the 35% bracket clears every main stage to 328-30; the 35% line there is 4.00G.
detail: Screenshots: 328-30 GingerCraven at 4.00G, 312-30 at 2.74G, 288-19 at 1.77G, 266-30 Cool Mint on auto at 1.17G.

text: On main stages, 15% works on mob stages and Cool Mint; GingerCraven, the bikers and the Redberry packs need 35%.
detail: 15% clears: 289-30 Cool Mint at 1.29G (screenshot), 301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G, 271-11 at 971.8M. A 15% GingerCraven run left 41% HP after an hour.

text: The cheapest damage is crossing the next bracket line: pad displayed power rather than fight a step lower.
detail: Both 15% mob clears sat 0.6M and 4.4M under the 40% line. Pad with a 뻥투 gear preset, SSR power rune lines, and a guild.

text: Run the Bari–Cherry Cola charge deck as the general deck and swap per boss slot; the zone cycle tells you which boss is next.
detail: Panda Dumpling for launch bosses; Scorpion and Jungle Warrior for GingerCraven; Jungle Warrior or Tiger Lily and Rye for Redberry; Ion and Icy Birdie for the truck.

text: Accuracy 900–1,000 is enough after the easing; focus matters for the debuffers.
detail: Accuracy caps at 1,203.5 from about chapter 248; ND러너 runs about 1,000 past 300 and calls 1,300 wasted. Dark Choco's shred needs focus.

text: In the Rift, every boss but GingerCraven falls at 15%; park at each GingerCraven until 차원의 힘 reaches its 35% line.
detail: Header power only. 15% screenshots: Werehound Princess level 18 (29.73G), Cool Mint 17 (32.97G), trucks 14 (28.76G), Cake Hounds 11 (18.55G).

text: 차원의 힘 fills only while idling in the Rift, at the level reached per minute: enter early, it compounds.
detail: Recommended power runs from 10.00G at level 1 to about 1,800G at level 100 (season 1); pushers gain about a level a day.

text: For the Rift's 15% decks, Milk captains at the top of the attack order and the off-buff cookies drop below Lv.100.
detail: Both perks land on Milk; Pomegranate's beam and the ATK-ordered buffs reach the dealers. Decks: rift-15-milk-first-*, rift-15-levelled-rye.
